segments.title: Into Westfall: Furlbrow's farm and Saldean's Farm

steps.tip: Skyborne: Bolvar sends you on to Westfall. Leave the city through the main gate and follow the road south-west through Elwynn.
Grab the Stormwind flight path in Old Town before you leave; Westfall quests send you back here.
Farmer Furlbrow and his wife camp by the road just after the bridge from Elwynn.
Skyborne can take this bounty too; it ends at the same captain.
Saldean's Farm is further south along the road.
New in Forever: Ozwin wants golem parts. Harvest golems drop them, so do it with The Killing Fields.
Sentinel Hill is the stone tower in the middle of Westfall.
Red Leather Bandanas drop from every Defias in Westfall; they fill up while you do the other quests.
Humans: Lewis's note chain flies you to Stormwind and back for good XP.
New in Forever: Alba Fairmoon's chain ends in the Deadmines, but the first parts are open-world.
Make Sentinel Hill your home; every loop in Westfall starts and ends here.

segments.title: Northern Westfall: Molsen Farm, Jangolode and the coast

steps.tip: Young Goretusks and Young Fleshrippers roam the fields around Saldean's Farm.
The Molsen Farm well is in the farmyard west of Saldean's.
Harvest Watchers fill the fields around the Molsen Farm. Okra drops from any golem.
The parts drop from Harvest Watchers and Golems while you clear the fields.
Oat sacks lie in every field here; click them between pulls.
If a golem drops a Precessive Autocognition Assembly, it starts a new quest for Ozwin.
Defias Trappers and Smugglers camp in the fields north of the Molsen Farm, toward the Jangolode Mine.
The wardrobe is inside the old Furlbrow farmhouse, guarded by Defias.
The Jansen Stead well is just west of Farmer Furlbrow's camp.
Murlocs line the north coast. Both gills and eyes drop from any of them.
Coast murlocs sometimes drop Captain Sander's Treasure Map. If you get it, the treasure hunt fits into the west-coast loop.
Riverpaw Gnolls camp in the hills above the north coast.
Head back south to Saldean's Farm.
Back to Sentinel Hill.

segments.title: Gold Coast Quarry and Jangolode Mine

steps.tip: Riverpaw Miners work the Gold Coast Quarry on the west coast.
steps.speed: Speedrun: run straight to the quarry and the mine; skip the treasure hunt and Ozwin's second order.

steps.tip: The captain's footlocker sits on the beach just west of the quarry.
Murloc Hunters on the beach drop the scope and modulators.
The broken barrel is by the ruined chimney east of the quarry.
Kobold Diggers are inside Jangolode Mine in the north. Trappers outside also drop bandanas.
The old jug stands by the windmill near the mine.
The locked chest is on the north-west shore.
Finish the isosprings on Harvest Golems on the way back south.
Back to Alba at Sentinel Hill.
Defias Pillagers and Looters hold the Dagger Hills and the road into Moonbrook. Pillagers cast; kill them first.
The suspicious crates sit around the Moonbrook buildings.
Finish the bandanas on the Defias in and around Moonbrook.

Captain Grayson keeps the lighthouse on the south-west tip. His oil comes from the harvest golems you meet later; skip The Coast Isn't Clear for now, its murlocs are 16-19 and spread along the whole coast.
Hearth back to Sentinel Hill.
steps.speed: If your hearth is down, die near Moonbrook and take the spirit healer at Sentinel Hill.

steps.tip: Thor flies you to Stormwind. Humans need this flight for Lewis's note anyway.
Osric Strang's shop is in Old Town.
Baros Alexston in Cathedral Square wants his old compass from his Westfall farmhouse. You hand it in when you leave Westfall through Stormwind.
Rogues: hand Shaw the shipping schedule from Jerod's Landing.
Sprite Jumpsprocket is in the Dwarven District.
Jasper Fel is in SI:7 in Old Town.
Back to Sprite. The next step needs 10 Rough Dynamite from an engineer or the auction house; only bother if you plan to run the Deadmines.
If you plan to run the Deadmines: Sprite also wants 10 Rough Dynamite (engineers or the auction house).
Paladins: Duthorian Rall is in the Cathedral of Light. The Tome of Divinity chain ends with Redemption.
steps.text: Turn in Tome of Divinity to Duthorian Rall, then start The Tome of Divinity from the book he hands you

steps.tip: Stephanie Turner is in the Trade District.
Bring 10 Linen Cloth; you should have plenty from the Defias.
Henze Faulk lies by the road near Stone Cairn Lake in eastern Elwynn; use the Symbol of Life on him.
The Defias Script drops from Rogue Wizards north of Stone Cairn Lake.
Back to Gazin Tenorm in the Cathedral.
Wilder Thistlenettle in the Dwarven District wants union cards from the Deadmines.
Shoni is in the Dwarven District next to the tram.
Take the Deeprun Tram from the Dwarven District to Ironforge. Thom Filch wants heirlooms from the new Hall of Thanes.

steps.text: Enter the Hall of Thanes from Old Ironforge, off the Throne Room
steps.tip: New in Forever. A full party at 15 is comfortable. Instance entries are capped per hour, so don't reset carelessly.
The Ghostly Attendant inside the dungeon gives this one.
steps.text: Accept An Ancient Grudge from the Ghostly Attendant inside the Hall of Thanes

steps.tip: Heirlooms are glowing objects along the halls; everyone in the party can loot them.
The Treaty of Understanding is in the last vault. It cannot be shared; each player loots their own.

steps.text: Turn in An Ancient Grudge to the Ghostly Attendant

steps.tip: Magni is in the Throne Room. Take the tram back to Stormwind afterwards.
Fly back to Westfall.
Quartermaster Lewis is at the top of Sentinel Hill.
The last militia order is tougher: Highwaymen are 17-18. Pull one at a time.
Harvest Golems in the fields west of Sentinel Hill drop the Flasks of Oil.
Alexston's chest is in the ruined farmhouse on the way to Moonbrook.
Highwaymen, Pathstalkers and Knuckledusters hold the roads and ridges around Moonbrook.

steps.text: If you are still short of 17, keep killing Defias Highwaymen around Moonbrook
steps.tip: The route's XP count assumes no extra kills, so most players are already close. With dungeons on, the Deadmines run covers this instead.
steps.speed: Pull Highwaymen in pairs along the Moonbrook road; stop the moment you hit 17.

steps.tip: Down to the lighthouse with the oil.
Back to Gryan at Sentinel Hill.
steps.speed: Hearth or deathskip back to Sentinel Hill.

steps.tip: Alba gives you the explosives for the Deadmines forge.
The entrance is in the Moonbrook house on the hill. Union cards drop from the undead miners in the first tunnels.
Plant the explosives next to the goblin forge.
Sneed's Shredder drops the Gnoam Sprecklesprocket.
Alba waits outside the Deadmines exit on the coast.
Fly to Stormwind; Redridge starts from there.
